description: Check an MCP server's tool list as a client reads it: start or connect to it, list its tools, and report findings (what clients reject, what breaks prompt caches, what agents misread) and the token cost. A command server is started by running command as given, so only pass a command you would run yourself. Writes the menu file only when save_as is given (the baseline for diff_menus): a new file inside cwd, or an existing menu file there.

catalog.description: Also read the operations behind a search tool or command routers.

client.description: Also check the menu as this client loads it: what it cuts, finds and refuses.

command.description: The command that starts a stdio server, one word per item: ["node", "dist/server.js"]. Give this or url.

cwd.description: Folder to run from: where the server starts, toolmenu.config.json is read and relative paths resolve. Default: where toolmenu mcp runs.

env.description: Environment variables for a command server. It gets a minimal environment plus these.

headers.description: HTTP headers for a url server: {"Authorization": "Bearer ..."}.

save_as.description: Write the menu here (menu.json for a baseline), relative to cwd and inside it: a new file, or a menu file to replace. Default: not written.

url.description: A Streamable HTTP endpoint: https://example.com/mcp. Give this or command.

name: snapshot_menu
